content.comment_body: Hello everyone, which operator panel model can be used with [product_name] MLFB [article_no], and which cable should be used?
Hello, Please verify the MLFB of your current [product_name] module.

Hello, In that case, only the dedicated [product_name] text display can be used. [article_no] is the Text Display, 4-line, including connecting cable. Keep in mind that both the controller and the text display are considered spare parts.
